clusters.headline: President Subianto To Select New Vice President After State Visits
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto intends to begin the search for a new vice president after concluding his state visits to China and the Philippines.
The President has requested coalition parties to prepare potential candidates for the position within a one-week timeframe.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Attends Muhammadiyah Tanwir In Palu City
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially opened the 2026 Tanwir and 114th anniversary celebration of Muhammadiyah at the University of Muhammadiyah Palu.
During the event, the President acknowledged Muhammadiyah for its management of significant financial resources and its contributions to public sectors.

clusters.headline: Indonesia U17 National Team Secures Victory Against Cambodia
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesia U17 football team defeated Cambodia 2-0 during a Group A match in the 2027 AFC U17 Asian Cup qualification round.
This outcome marks the second straight win for the Indonesian squad within the qualifying competition.

clusters.headline: Political Response And Economic Outlook Following Gibran Resignation
aiSummaryBullets: The People's Consultative Assembly of Indonesia is conducting joint meetings to establish a verification team for a new vice presidential candidate.
Economic officials have stated that national targets and investment climates should remain stable provided the political transition is managed in an orderly fashion.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Commends New Police Chief Suyudi Ario
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto publicly commended General Suyudi Ario Seto during the 114th Muhammadiyah Tanwir event.
Prabowo described the new police chief as an inspiring and calming figure for the country.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Confers Honors On Forest Fire Response Personnel
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto awarded Bintang Jasa honors to 23 volunteers and health workers injured or killed during forest fire missions.
The government has committed to ensuring the welfare and future of the families affected by the incidents.

clusters.headline: Authorities Investigate Fatal Tower Crane Collapse In Mega Kuningan
aiSummaryBullets: A construction crane collapsed at a hotel project site in the Mega Kuningan district of South Jakarta on Friday.
The incident resulted in the death of one construction worker.

clusters.headline: Government Expands Support For Sekolah Rakyat Education Programs
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Social Affairs has formally inaugurated 2,394 new teachers as government contract employees for Sekolah Rakyat.
The Ministry of Public Works has announced the completion of construction for five new Sekolah Rakyat facilities in the Aceh region.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Prepares For Upcoming Guns N' Roses And BTS Performances
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung expects major international concerts to bolster local tourism and economic activity.
City authorities will extend operating hours for public transportation, including MRT, LRT, and TransJakarta, to accommodate concert attendees.

clusters.headline: Indonesia Outlines Energy Transition Strategy At Global Forums
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia introduced a new energy transition toolkit during the COP31 conference held in Antalya.
The Deputy Speaker of the People's Consultative Assembly reaffirmed the nation's commitment to energy shifts at the Global Finance Summit.
